topic: Firelight Phase 2: official confirmation of stablecoin first-loss reserve and USDC-to-FXRP auto-compounding
confirmed_mechanics: The First-Loss Buffer is a dedicated protocol-owned stablecoin reserve and absorbs the first tranche of a validated cover claim.
After the First-Loss Buffer is exhausted, staked FXRP is slashed pro rata to fund remaining covered losses.
Fees paid in USDC convert back to FXRP and flow automatically into staker positions; the rewards auto-compound and increase redemption value and slashable exposure.
The unstaking window extends to align with active 30-day coverage periods; exact total duration is not stated.
Kraken Protected Strategies USDC is curated by Sentora and covered by Firelight. Platform access, vault curation/infrastructure and coverage are separate roles.

economics_and_risk.implication: USDC fee streams can create a protocol-level FXRP reward conversion mechanism, but no actual fee amount or transaction-level conversion has yet been traced. It is not proof of new XRP spot buying.
